events.title: Dutch club 포르튀나 시타르트 has three points deducted for financial mismanagement (failure to settle tax debts); an additional deduction of three points on April 29 was confirmed after an appeal on June 13.
Swiss AXPO Super League – Club Servette FC was declared bankrupt. It had run debts of over 10 million Swiss francs. As a consequence of the bankruptcy the club will be demoted two divisions.
첼시 , the Premier League leaders, face a Premier League inquiry over an alleged illegal approach for 아스널 defender 애슐리 콜 . If found guilty, 첼시 face a hefty fine and possibly even a points deduction.
맨체스터 유나이티드 confirms that United States businessman Malcolm Glazer has made an £ 800 million bid to take over the club.

첼시 win the League Cup beating 리버풀 3–2 after extra time, meaning that the sixth placed club will get a UEFA Cup place this season if 리버풀 achieve a top five finish that 첼시 are on the verge of sealing any time now. In the Premier League, 첼시 now lead six points ahead of 맨체스터 유나이티드 and have a game in hand. 아스널, 에버턴, 리버풀 and 미들즈브러 complete the top six. 웨스트브로미치 앨비언 continue to prop up the table, with 노리치 시티 and 사우샘프턴 completing the bottom three. 위건 애슬레틱, 선덜랜드 and 입스위치 타운 are level on 66 points at the top of the Championship. 더비 카운티, 웨스트햄 유나이티드 and 프레스턴 노스 엔드 complete the top six.
